title: The Ghost Ship Found With No One On Board 😨

scenes.narration: In 1872, sailors found a ship drifting in the Atlantic. It was still sailing. But no one was on board.
Her name was the Mary Celeste. She had left New York a month earlier with ten people on board.
The crew of another ship spotted her near the Azores, moving strangely, like nobody was steering.
When they climbed aboard, the ship was empty. The lifeboat was gone.
But there was food. There was water. And the cargo of alcohol was almost untouched.
The captain, his wife, their little daughter, and seven crew members were never seen again.
Storms, pirates, toxic fumes. Over 150 years later, nobody knows why ten people left a perfectly good ship.

summary: A ship found sailing with no one on board. Ten people gone without a trace.
instagram_caption:
Would you leave a safe ship for a tiny lifeboat? 👀
The Mary Celeste mystery is still unsolved.
claims: The Mary Celeste was found abandoned in 1872 near the Azores
The alcohol cargo was mostly intact
